title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)
description:
Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location - Brazil


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.

Key Responsibilities

· Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets

· Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions

· Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting

· Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting

· Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability

· Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated


CRFs

· Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues

· Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation


Required Qualifications

· Strong experience with SAS programming

· Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)

· Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions

· Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes

· Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)

· Strong attention to detail and documentation practices


Preferred

· Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions

· Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Líder de Fábrica de Software SAP ABAP e BW


Remoto - Brasil.

Horário - Comercial.


Procuramos profissional experiente para conduzir e desenvolver equipes SAP ABAP e BW. Profissional focado em liderança técnica, governança de entregas e capacitação de times, que será o ponto focal de sustentação e projetos.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear competências técnicas e gaps da equipe, identificando planos de desenvolvimento individuais;

  • Definir, implantar e acompanhar o programa de capacitação e certificação das equipes;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de profissionais em início de carreira e de novos consultores, garantindo ramp-up eficiente;
  • Organizar a cobertura de férias, assegurando continuidade das entregas;
  • Acompanhar e garantir o apontamento correto de horas e conformidade com políticas internas;
  • Apoiar processos de contratação e desligamento de consultores, em alinhamento com RH;

  • Colaborar com a gerência e stakeholders para priorização de demandas e mitigação de riscos técnicos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes técnicas SAP ABAP e BW;
  • Habilidade em mapear competências, estruturar equipes e implantar programas de capacitação;
  • Experiência na organização de cobertura de férias, gestão de apontamento de horas e suporte a processos de contratação/desligamento;
  • Boa comunicação com stakeholders e capacidade de atuar como ponto focal entre sustentação e projetos;

  • Experiência prática com SAP BW (modelos, extração/transformação, carregamento e performance);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis e governança de fábrica de desenvolvimento;
  • Graduação completa.


Qualificações desejáveis:

  • Familiaridade com BASIS;
  • Experiência anterior em estruturação de programas de treinamento/capacitação/bootcamps;
  • Certificações SAP e/ou experiência em projetos de grande porte;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente);
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);
  • Terapia online;
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges);
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos);
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna);
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa);
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento).

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

title: Desenvolvedor ADVPL
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.



O que buscamos?

Desenvolvedor ADVPL Sênior


Principais responsabilidades técnicas:

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor, para atuar com foco em soluções no ERP Protheus . O profissional deve possuir conhecimento avançado em ADVPL , TLPP e SQL , garantindo autonomia técnica para desenvolvimento e sustentação de customizações. É desejável certificação Totvs como desenvolvedor.


Entre as principais responsabilidades estão o desenvolvimento de APIs para integrações entre o Protheus e outras aplicações, criação de relatórios personalizados conforme as necessidades do negócio e correção de bugs em fontes customizadas do sistema, assegurando a estabilidade e performance das soluções implementadas.


Serão considerados diferenciais experiência com desenvolvimentos nos módulos de Gestão de Ativos e Contratos, bem como atuação com o Fluig. Buscamos um perfil proativo, analítico e com capacidade de atuar tanto em demandas de sustentação quanto em novos desenvolvimentos.


CLT FULL + Benefícios

Atuação de forma remota.


O que oferecemos?

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.


O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Minas Gerais
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Partner Lead - Creator & IRL Business
description:
The position can be based anywhere in Latin America (Fully Remote).


About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

The next phase of growth is expanding our creator and IRL ecosystem globally, and LATAM is a key frontier.



Role Overview

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.


What You'll Do

  • Recruit and activate partners (agencies, resellers, production, creator networks)
  • Drive revenue across packs, data, support and mobile apps.
  • Support partners through deals, logistics, and deployments
  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent
  • Identify growth opportunities and execute locally
  • Help solve operational and market entry challenges
  • Collaborate with global partner and regional teams


Success Looks Like

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets
  • New creator and partner deals closed
  • Growing regional revenue contribution
  • Clear pipeline and local momentum
  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU


Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on
  • Strong network in media, creators, streaming, or tech
  • Comfortable owning revenue outcomes
  • Fluent Spanish and English (Portuguese a big plus)
  • Thrive in fast, ambiguous environments


Why This Role

  • Remote position anywhere in Latin America with high autonomy
  • Be part of a fast-paced, fast-growing Silicon Valley company with 300+ team members worldwide
  • Work at the center of the rapidly evolving creator economy
  • You’ll help shape how the next generation of live creators operates, with real ownership, global visibility, and direct impact on growth



Please note that your application will only be considered if your CV and email are sent directly to:  


TVU Networks is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage those who meet the qualifications to apply.


Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

title: Senior IBM Webmethods Developer
description:
Descrição da empresa


A Inetum é uma empresa global de tecnologia e consultoria, especializada em transformação digital. Com presença no Brasil, oferecemos soluções inovadoras e personalizadas para diversos setores, como financeiro, industrial, saúde e governo. Nossa missão é impulsionar o crescimento das organizações por meio de tecnologias emergentes, como inteligência artificial, big data e IoT, sempre com uma abordagem local e foco em resultados. Se você busca fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e orientada à inovação, venha crescer conosco!


Descrição do emprego


Profissional sénior com mais de 8 anos de experiência em integração de sistemas empresariais (EAI) utilizando o IBM WebMethods Integration Server , especializado no desenho, desenvolvimento e otimização de soluções de integração de alta disponibilidade. Forte capacidade de análise, visão arquitetural e foco na entrega de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas com as melhores práticas de integração.


Qualificações


Plataforma WebMethods

  • Desenvolvimento avançado em Integration Server , Broker , Universal Messaging , Trading Networks e MyWebMethods Server .
  • Criação e manutenção de flows , services , adapters , packages , document types , schemas e triggers .
  • Experiência sólida com web services SOAP/REST , APIs , WSDL , Swagger/OpenAPI .
  • Integração com sistemas externos via JDBC , SAP Adapter , MQ , FTP/SFTP , JMS , Kafka .
  • Gestão e otimização de pipelines , error handling , logging , monitorização e performance tuning .

Arquitetura e Integração

  • Desenho de arquiteturas SOA , ESB , microserviços e event-driven .
  • Modelação de integrações complexas entre sistemas ERP, CRM, billing, logística e plataformas cloud.
  • Experiência com CI/CD , versionamento e automação de deploys (Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
  • Conhecimento de padrões de integração (EIP), mensageria e governança de APIs.

Linguagens e Ferramentas

  • Java, SQL, XML, XSLT, JSON.
  • Docker, Kubernetes (desejável).
  • Ferramentas de monitorização e logging (Splunk, Kibana, Dynatrace).


Informações adicionais


  • Disponibilidade: Atuar no fuso horário da Europa (6h às 15h)
  • 100% home office

  • Profesional en economía, ingeniería, administración, finanzas, sistemas, derecho, relaciones internacionales o áreas afines. Deseable, posgrado en gestión de proyectos, innovación, sistemas financieros o transformación digital.

Prestación de servicios, a un (1) año.

title: Wiper
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give an unique development opportunity for our seafarers. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.


This job opportunity is for an Wiper to one of our foreign-flagged Shuttle Tankers with a 42x42 shift and international crew. We are looking for qualified and committed professionals to join our team.


Requirements:

- Bridge watch (Rule III/4)

- Tank low.g. Oil (EBPQ) V/1

- Security duties training (EFNT/EBCP) VI/6

- CIR

- Passport

- Yellow fever vaccine

- 2nd Dose COVID-19 (ConectSUS)

- Advanced English


Benefits:

-Food voucher

-Health plan extended to dependents, free of charge

-Life insurance, free of charge

-Boarding and disembarking assistance

-Double food voucher in December

-Wellhub membership: Gold+ plan 100% covered by the company


Note: All logistics are the responsibility of KNOT, regardless of your state of residence.


If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals and offers development opportunities, apply with us.


All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!


Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Made Simpler

Made Simpler exists to empower small and medium-sized businesses to grow smarter, stronger, and with real impact. We believe opportunity should not be defined by company size or available resources. With the right system in place, any business can compete, scale, and lead.

We are the world’s first Wholesale Marketing Agency , delivering Managed Marketing as a Service (MMaaS), a powerful combination of strategic human expertise and AI acceleration. Our model provides accessible, scalable, and results-driven marketing and revenue engines, leveling the playing field for growing businesses.

About the role

We are looking for a Video Editor with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence tools , capable of creating highly persuasive videos for Social Media, Ads, and institutional content.

This role requires the ability to balance human storytelling with AI efficiency, producing high-quality, scalable, and performance-driven video content.

This is a full time opportunity, 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video editing and assembly: transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and cohesive narratives across multiple platforms, including social media, websites, and advertising.
  • Mastery of video editing tools: work with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut Pro (or similar).
  • AI-powered video creation: leverage generative AI platforms to create avatars, videos, and unique visual assets, with a strong focus on tools like Creatify AI.
  • Asset organization and management: maintain efficient organization of files, versions, and workflows using tools such as Notion and Google Drive.
  • Platform optimization: adapt formats, aspect ratios, codecs, and audio levels to maximize performance across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and paid ads.

Must haves

  • Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to video creation and post-production, such as Midjourney, Creatify AI, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Google Flow, etc.
  • Strong storytelling ability, with a solid grasp of pacing, persuasion, and visual composition.
  • Technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, compression, color correction/grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
  • Intermediate to advanced English

Proficiência em Python (scripts, ETL, integração de dados)

Experiência com Apache NiFi e Apache Airflow

Familiaridade com arquitetura de Data Lake

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais

Conhecimento em modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados

title: Portuguese Customer Support (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Portuguese-speaking Customer Support Specialist to join our remote team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our Portuguese-speaking users and our global operations team, ensuring world-class support via Zendesk while contributing to the localized growth of the Airbrush app.


What you will do:

  • Customer Interaction: Handle Portuguese user inquiries (including some English tickets) via the Zendesk support system, providing efficient and professional assistance.
  • Issue Tracking: Document and organize user feedback and technical issues, ensuring they are synced with the User Operations team in a timely manner.
  • Team Collaboration: Maintain close communication with the User Operations team to assist in following up on and resolving complex cases.


Who we're looking for:

  • Language Proficiency: Major in Portuguese or equivalent proficiency; excellent written and verbal Portuguese skills are required. Strong written English or Chinese proficiency is a HUGE PLUS.
  • Experience: Prior experience in customer service, online support, or related fields is preferred.
  • Soft Skills: Detail-oriented, patient, and highly responsible.



Work Schedule:

  • Commitment: 6 days per week, approximately 2 hours per day (flexible by ±1 hour depending on ticket volume).
  • Flexibility: Remote position with flexible hours; however, you must ensure timely responses (all inquiries must be addressed within 24 hours).


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.

Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Analista Contábil
description:
Principal Desafio: Garantir a correta apuração, análise e cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e contábeis da empresa, assegurando conformidade com a legislação vigente, atendimento às auditorias e qualidade nas informações reportadas aos órgãos reguladores e à matriz.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar contabilizações e conciliações contábeis, incluindo processos judiciais
  • Preparar e analisar relatórios contábeis e fiscais (BRGAAP)
  • Atender demandas de auditoria interna e externa
  • Preparar, analisar e reportar informações fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, SPED Contábil, e-LALUR, entre outros)
  • Elaborar balanços patrimoniais conforme legislação societária
  • Revisar reconciliações contábeis (BRGAAP/USGAAP)
  • Monitorar CNDs e acompanhar comunicações nos sistemas E-CAC, Siare e SIGISS
  • Revisar registros contábeis garantindo conformidade com normas e práticas internas
  • Controlar ativos fixos e realizar cálculo mensal de depreciação
  • Gerenciar despesas por centro de custo
  • Atender exigências relacionadas às demonstrações financeiras
  • Acompanhar e orientar processos financeiros e fiscais fora da rotina operacional

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis
  • CRC ativo
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano na área contábil/fiscal
  • Experiência com auditoria externa será um diferencial
  • Inglês intermediário
  • Conhecimento em conciliação contábil
  • Experiência em contabilidade industrial
  • Conhecimento em IFRS
  • Conhecimento em regime especial de ICMS
  • Conhecimento em análise de balanço
  • Conhecimento em cálculo de IRPJ e CSLL
  • Boa capacidade de adaptação a prazos

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Senso de responsabilidade e comprometimento com resultados
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e prazos desafiadores
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Proatividade e autonomia
  • Trabalho em equipe e compartilhamento de conhecimento
  • Atualização constante sobre legislação fiscal e contábil

title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer

(Mid–Senior Level)

12 month contract

Remote


Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade ML models while supporting the backend infrastructure required to run them at scale. This is a hands-on role combining applied machine learning, cloud engineering, and data pipeline development, with a strong focus on AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine systems.


Key Responsibilities


Take ownership of end-to-end ML production deployment, building and shipping new models largely from scratch, with responsibility for architecture, deployment pipelines, and operational reliability in collaboration with backend engineering.


  • Design, train, deploy, and maintain machine learning models for production use, including AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine features
  • Build and integrate backend infrastructure to support ML models and data pipelines
  • Work with cloud-based systems to manage model training, deployment, and monitoring
  • Improve data ingestion pipelines and feature engineering processes
  • Develop scalable, reliable ML services in collaboration with backend engineering
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions
  • Communicate progress proactively and contribute to technical decision-making


Required Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI-related roles
  • Strong Python proficiency for ML development and data processing
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models into production environments
  • 2+ years of practical experience working with AWS infrastructure
  • Solid background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical discipline


Required Technical Skills

  • Python (advanced)
  • Production ML model development and training
  • Experience building content moderation systems and/or recommendation engines
  • AWS (deployment and infrastructure management), including:
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS SQS
  • AWS DynamoDB
  • AWS Kinesis or Kafka
  • Experience with at least one ML framework:
  • PyTorch or TensorFlow

title: Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)
description:
Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Technical) to join our 24/7 operations team, which operates at the core of platform stability, partner communication, and incident handling. In this role, you’ll work on the frontline monitoring platform health, investigating issues, and coordinating real-time responses to ensure stable and reliable operations for our partners. This role is about real-time reaction, investigation, coordination, and clear communication.


Responsibilities:  


  • Actively monitor platform health and alerts during your shift and react to incidents in real time
  • Investigate partner-raised issues and perform first-level technical analysis using logs and monitoring dashboards
  • Communicate clearly with partners during incidents, outages, and escalations
  • Own issues throughout their full life cycle: detection, investigation, coordination, and resolution
  • Create and manage Jira tickets and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
  • Provide transparent updates internally and externally
  • Identify recurring issues and risks that may impact platform stability
  • Maintain accurate documentation and structured internal communication


Requirements:


  • Junior to early-mid level profile 
  • Strong written and verbal English skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment
  • Logical, analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem solving
  • Technically curious and comfortable working with system behavior, logs, and monitoring tools
  • Experience or familiarity with Jira, Slack, or similar tools
  • Able to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 rotation
  • Calm under pressure and confident handling incidents and escalations


Things we consider as an advantage:


  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Technical Support, NOC, or Operations
  • Experience with monitoring tools
  • Exposure to SaaS, platform-based products, or iGaming
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, APIs, or backend systems


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.

We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer

(Mid–Senior Level)

12 month contract

Remote


Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade ML models while supporting the backend infrastructure required to run them at scale. This is a hands-on role combining applied machine learning, cloud engineering, and data pipeline development, with a strong focus on AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine systems.


Key Responsibilities


Take ownership of end-to-end ML production deployment, building and shipping new models largely from scratch, with responsibility for architecture, deployment pipelines, and operational reliability in collaboration with backend engineering.


  • Design, train, deploy, and maintain machine learning models for production use, including AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine features
  • Build and integrate backend infrastructure to support ML models and data pipelines
  • Work with cloud-based systems to manage model training, deployment, and monitoring
  • Improve data ingestion pipelines and feature engineering processes
  • Develop scalable, reliable ML services in collaboration with backend engineering
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions
  • Communicate progress proactively and contribute to technical decision-making


Required Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI-related roles
  • Strong Python proficiency for ML development and data processing
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models into production environments
  • 2+ years of practical experience working with AWS infrastructure
  • Solid background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical discipline


Required Technical Skills

  • Python (advanced)
  • Production ML model development and training
  • Experience building content moderation systems and/or recommendation engines
  • AWS (deployment and infrastructure management), including:
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS SQS
  • AWS DynamoDB
  • AWS Kinesis or Kafka
  • Experience with at least one ML framework:
  • PyTorch or TensorFlow

description:

Atuação 100% remota!

• 3+ anos de experiência com Unity e/ou Godot

• 2+ anos de experiência em um tópico específico como shaders, motion ou multiplayer

Candidate-se agora e venha desenvolver o futuro com a gente!

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP CPI - Plenio/Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado para atuar na integração de sistemas SAP, garantindo conectividade eficiente entre diferentes plataformas e aplicações empresariais. O candidato ideal terá experiência em arquiteturas de integração, desenvolvimento de interfaces e uso de ferramentas específicas do ecossistema SAP, e deve ter inglês em nível avançado para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter integrações entre o SAP e outros sistemas (internos e externos).
  • Trabalhar com middleware e tecnologias de integração como SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, BTP, API Management e Web Services (SOAP/REST).
  • Implementar e monitorar processos de troca de dados via IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Garantir a segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência das integrações.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e negócio para alinhar soluções às necessidades estratégicas da empresa.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas de integração, otimizando processos e garantindo alta disponibilidade.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e boas práticas de integração.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada com integração de sistemas SAP.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), API Management e Web Services.
  • Experiência com IDocs, RFCs, OData e BAPIs.
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação e formatos de dados como XML, JSON, EDIFACT e CSV.
  • Conhecimento em ABAP, Java, JavaScript ou Groovy para customizações de integração.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA) e microsserviços.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação em projetos internacionais.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Certificações SAP em integração (ex.: SAP Certified Development Associate - SAP Integration Suite).
  • Experiência com SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Conhecimento em integrações com SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, C/4HANA e outras soluções SAP.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer

(Mid–Senior Level)

12 month contract

Remote


Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade ML models while supporting the backend infrastructure required to run them at scale. This is a hands-on role combining applied machine learning, cloud engineering, and data pipeline development, with a strong focus on AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine systems.


Key Responsibilities


Take ownership of end-to-end ML production deployment, building and shipping new models largely from scratch, with responsibility for architecture, deployment pipelines, and operational reliability in collaboration with backend engineering.


  • Design, train, deploy, and maintain machine learning models for production use, including AI Content Moderation and Recommendation Engine features
  • Build and integrate backend infrastructure to support ML models and data pipelines
  • Work with cloud-based systems to manage model training, deployment, and monitoring
  • Improve data ingestion pipelines and feature engineering processes
  • Develop scalable, reliable ML services in collaboration with backend engineering
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions
  • Communicate progress proactively and contribute to technical decision-making


Required Experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI-related roles
  • Strong Python proficiency for ML development and data processing
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models into production environments
  • 2+ years of practical experience working with AWS infrastructure
  • Solid background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical discipline


Required Technical Skills

  • Python (advanced)
  • Production ML model development and training
  • Experience building content moderation systems and/or recommendation engines
  • AWS (deployment and infrastructure management), including:
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS SQS
  • AWS DynamoDB
  • AWS Kinesis or Kafka
  • Experience with at least one ML framework:
  • PyTorch or TensorFlow

title: Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)
description:
Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Technical) to join our 24/7 operations team, which operates at the core of platform stability, partner communication, and incident handling. In this role, you’ll work on the frontline monitoring platform health, investigating issues, and coordinating real-time responses to ensure stable and reliable operations for our partners. This role is about real-time reaction, investigation, coordination, and clear communication.


Responsibilities:  


  • Actively monitor platform health and alerts during your shift and react to incidents in real time
  • Investigate partner-raised issues and perform first-level technical analysis using logs and monitoring dashboards
  • Communicate clearly with partners during incidents, outages, and escalations
  • Own issues throughout their full life cycle: detection, investigation, coordination, and resolution
  • Create and manage Jira tickets and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
  • Provide transparent updates internally and externally
  • Identify recurring issues and risks that may impact platform stability
  • Maintain accurate documentation and structured internal communication


Requirements:


  • Junior to early-mid level profile 
  • Strong written and verbal English skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment
  • Logical, analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem solving
  • Technically curious and comfortable working with system behavior, logs, and monitoring tools
  • Experience or familiarity with Jira, Slack, or similar tools
  • Able to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 rotation
  • Calm under pressure and confident handling incidents and escalations


Things we consider as an advantage:


  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Technical Support, NOC, or Operations
  • Experience with monitoring tools
  • Exposure to SaaS, platform-based products, or iGaming
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, APIs, or backend systems


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.

We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:
China Mobile International Limited (CMI) is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Mobile. In order to provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, China Mobile established CMI in December 2010, headquartered in Hong Kong, China. CMI has expanded its footprint in 39 countries and regions.

Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international information services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users.


We are looking for a dynamic and proactive Senior Carrier Business Development Executive to join our team.


This role is responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, account management, and strategic carrier partnerships across Voice, A2P messaging, and eSIM mobility products. The position plays a critical role in expanding market penetration, optimizing commercial conditions, and ensuring smooth operational execution in close collaboration with internal, regional, and HQ teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish, develop, and expand business relationships with customers and partners across Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility products, driving new revenue opportunities and account growth.
  • Define and execute sales and business development strategies, managing a structured sales pipeline by customer account and region to achieve revenue and market penetration targets.
  • Manage customer accounts end to end, including commercial negotiations, daily operational follow-up, service performance review, and after-sales support.
  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global Voice, A2P, and mobile carriers, leading negotiations to secure competitive pricing, routing, capacity, and commercial terms.
  • Lead carrier and customer contract execution, including onboarding, implementation, performance monitoring, and renewals.
  • Monitor market trends, customer needs, and carrier performance to identify growth, optimization, and partnership opportunities.
  • Support the optimization of Voice, A2P and/or eSIM mobility supply networks, ensuring service continuity, cost efficiency, and scalability.
  • Work closely with internal commercial, technical, and operational teams to ensure smooth end-to-end execution from opportunity identification to service activation.
  • Collaborate with HQ and regional teams to align on sales targets, partnership strategies, and overall business performance.
  • Analyze commercial and operational performance and prepare sales and performance reports for management review.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Solid telecommunications experience in the LATAM market.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.


Preferred Requirements:

  • Advanced to fluent proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Arquiteto de Software (JAVA)
description:
Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da SONDA?

Porque assim como você, amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

Na SONDA você terá uma experiência de trabalho com diversas oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Um excelente lugar para aprender e contribuir para melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da tecnologia.

Procuramos Desenvolvedor e Arquiteto Java que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato 100% Remoto de 09:00 às 18:00 (SEG/SEX)

Nesta função você irá:

  • Ser profissional líder e responsável por definir e viabilizar a aplicação das melhores soluções técnicas em produtos de software que atendam aos requisitos determinados pelo cliente.
  • Pesquisar, implementar, descrever e disseminar decisões e boas práticas, prezando pela alta qualidade dos artefatos técnicos.
  • Apoia as equipes e tem interesse e habilidade em buscar e implantar soluções para os desafios técnicos dos projetos.
  • Propor normas e padrões de desenvolvimento dos produtos gerados para os clientes, validar tecnicamente as soluções de acordo à evolução dos produtos (Arq. banco de dados, componentes) para garantir a qualidade dos produtos entregues.
  • Desenvolve papel ativo como membro da divisão e na evolução das práticas e procedimentos definidos pela área.
  • Propõe e justifica as instruções do produto dentro das diretrizes aprovadas.
  • Definir as responsabilidades dos novos projetos, especifica, projeta e desenvolve softwares de acordo com os requisitos.
  • Orientação software de consulta e orientação estratégica associada ao desenvolvimento, projeto e depuração de aplicativos de software ou sistemas operacionais

Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência profissional como arquiteto ou líder técnico de projetos;
  • Experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software em ambiente corporativo.
  • Habilidades com Java >= 11, Spring Boot >= 2.5, OpenAPI, SQL e SQLServer, JS, TypeScript, Angular >= 18, REST, Git,
  • Conhecimento básico em Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Desenvolvimento de sistemas distribuídos, desenvolvimento de aplicações web e desenvolvimento para dispositivos móveis;
  • Práticas ágeis previstas em metodologias de desenvolvimento (XP, Scrum, etc);
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Práticas de gerência de configuração;
  • Conceitos e ferramentas de análise de qualidade de código;
  • TDD - Test Driven Development;
  • Arquitetura de sistemas Web (protocolos e padrões de integração, proxy, proxy reverso, WAF, CDN, servidores web, etc);
  • Protocolos de autenticação e autorização (Kerberos, OpenID, etc);
  • Administração de plataforma interna de desenvolvimento (repositório de código-fonte, ferramentas de gestão de tarefas e problemas e de avaliação de qualidade e segurança de código etc.);
  • Administração de sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux;
  • Ambientes de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Administração, configuração e distribuição de aplicações em ambiente de nuvem;
  • DevOps/DevSecOps;
  • MLOps/DataOps;
  • Segurança;
  • Nuvem;
  • Blockchain;
  • Linguagens específicas (Java, Python, Java script etc.);
  • Plataforma Microsoft 365;
  • Plataformas Low Code;
  • Ferramentas e plataformas de Inteligência Artificial e Aprendizado de Máquina;
  • Diferenciais: Experiência com IDPs e Github Enterprise.
  • Desejável: Inglês;

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Faça parte da nossa equipe!

title: Analista I de Desenvolvimento de Softare | Python
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


DESAFIO

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Python para integrar nosso time, focado

em construir e manter soluções técnicas de alta qualidade. Se você gosta de trabalhar com

metodologias ágeis e de criar aplicações escaláveis, essa oportunidade é para você.

  • Desenvolver e realizar a manutenção de aplicações utilizando frameworks Python (como FastAPI, Flask ou similares).
  • Criar, manter e evoluir APIs robustas, seguras e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar ativamente com a equipe na definição, desenho e implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Participar de ponta a ponta do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, atuando em um ambiente colaborativo e orientado por metodologias ágeis.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA

  • Experiência prática e comprovada com desenvolvimento em Python e frameworks web (FastAPI, Flask ou similares).
  • Sólida habilidade na construção, manutenção e consumo de APIs.
  • Vivência com modelagem e uso de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL).
  • Domínio de versionamento de código utilizando GIT.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência específica com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado e prático em arquitetura REST.
  • Vivência ou familiaridade com arquitetura de Microsserviços.
  • Prática na escrita de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração), preferencialmente utilizando pytest.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento Front-end para facilitar a integração entre as áreas.
  • Boa base em conceitos de arquitetura de software e vivência com frameworks ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the Opportunity:

Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.

You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.
  • Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.
  • Make cold calls when necessary.
  • Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.
  • Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).
  • Partner closely with Account Executives.


Requirements

  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.
  • Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Made Simpler

Made Simpler exists to empower small and medium-sized businesses to grow smarter, stronger, and with real impact. We believe opportunity should not be defined by company size or available resources. With the right system in place, any business can compete, scale, and lead.

We are the world’s first Wholesale Marketing Agency , delivering Managed Marketing as a Service (MMaaS), a powerful combination of strategic human expertise and AI acceleration. Our model provides accessible, scalable, and results-driven marketing and revenue engines, leveling the playing field for growing businesses.

About the role

We are looking for a Video Editor with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence tools , capable of creating highly persuasive videos for Social Media, Ads, and institutional content.

This role requires the ability to balance human storytelling with AI efficiency, producing high-quality, scalable, and performance-driven video content.

This is a full time opportunity, 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video editing and assembly: transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and cohesive narratives across multiple platforms, including social media, websites, and advertising.
  • Mastery of video editing tools: work with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut Pro (or similar).
  • AI-powered video creation: leverage generative AI platforms to create avatars, videos, and unique visual assets, with a strong focus on tools like Creatify AI.
  • Asset organization and management: maintain efficient organization of files, versions, and workflows using tools such as Notion and Google Drive.
  • Platform optimization: adapt formats, aspect ratios, codecs, and audio levels to maximize performance across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and paid ads.

Must haves

  • Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to video creation and post-production, such as Midjourney, Creatify AI, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Google Flow, etc.
  • Strong storytelling ability, with a solid grasp of pacing, persuasion, and visual composition.
  • Technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, compression, color correction/grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
  • Intermediate to advanced English

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!
