title: Supervisor Financeiro
description:
Como Supervisor Financeiro , você apoiará supervisionando a equipe de Contas a Pagar e Contas a Receber, otimizando fluxos de trabalho, solucionando questões operacionais e promovendo o desenvolvimento individual e da equipe, incluindo:


Principais atividades

  • Gerencia a equipe de Contas a Pagar e Contas a Receber, distribuindo tarefas, tratando desafios e promovendo um ambiente colaborativo;
  • Supervisiona e colabora na elaboração de relatórios detalhados, incluindo indicadores de cobrança e previsões de pagamentos para as partes interessadas internas;
  • Suporte técnico e administrativo à equipe contábil.
  • Monitora lançamentos financeiros, fiscais e de folha de pagamento no sistema ERP.
  • Acompanhar e realizar suporte na apuração das obrigações de IRPJ, CSLL e demais obrigações fiscais.


Nessa função você ficará alocado em nosso escritório na Av. Paulista , no horário administrativo.


Perfil desejado

Para ter sucesso nesta função, você precisará de:

  • Bacharel em Ciências Contábeis ou Administração;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • 3 anos de experiência na área, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais e/ou de auditoria/contabilidade;
  • Conhecimentos fiscais gerais (apuração de impostos diretos e indiretos);
  • Conhecimento em SAP ECC ou S4 (com experiência no módulo FI/CO) – será considerado um diferencial;
  • Habilidades com Pacote Office, preferencialmente Excel avançado.


O que você ganha com isso?

Com muitas oportunidades de desenvolvimento, você fará parte de uma equipe altamente competente e de uma empresa internacional que está em rápido crescimento que coloca a segurança e a sustentabilidade em primeiro lugar.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para integrar nosso time responsável pela evolução de uma plataforma Data Lakehouse na AWS . Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na integração de dados de múltiplas fontes, na orquestração de pipelines confiáveis e na disponibilização de camadas analíticas performáticas para consumo via Amazon Redshift e Power BI .


Modelo de atuação: Híbrido (2 a 3 vezes por semana)

Localidade: Brasília


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados utilizando Airflow/MWAA , com Python e SQL , seguindo boas práticas de modularidade, testes e versionamento.
  • Modelar camadas Bronze/Silver/Gold (arquitetura Medallion) em S3 + Glue Data Catalog , definindo partições, formatos (Parquet/Delta*) e tabelas otimizadas para consulta.
  • Construir e otimizar modelos analíticos em Amazon Redshift , garantindo performance e custo.
  • Publicar e manter datasets confiáveis para Power BI , incluindo gateways, incremental refresh, agregações e uso eficiente de DirectQuery/Import.
  • Colaborar com analistas e times de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em datasets, KPIs e camadas consumíveis, além de documentar catálogos e contratos de dados.


Requisitos e qualificações


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em AWS : S3, Glue Data Catalog, Airflow (preferencialmente MWAA), DAGs em Python, Amazon Redshift.
  • Linguagens: Python e SQL avançado .
  • Power BI : modelagem semântica, DAX, incremental refresh, gateway, boas práticas para consumo de Redshift.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura Data Lakehouse , formatos colunares (Parquet), partições e metadados.
  • Boas práticas de engenharia: Git, testes, code reviews, documentação, pipelines confiáveis.
  • Segurança e governança: IAM, criptografia, princípios de mínimo privilégio, LGPD aplicada a dados.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Analista de PCP
description:
Sobre a Adcos


Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades e um ambiente plural. Todos os candidatos serão considerados em nossos processos, independente de gênero, idade, etnia, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência.


A ADCOS é uma indústria brasileira de dermocosméticos comprometida com a saúde da pele dos brasileiros desde 1993. A busca incessante por tecnologia, alta eficácia e qualidade está no DNA da marca desde sua fundação pela Drª Ada Mota.

Atualmente possuímos linhas de tratamentos Home Care e Profissional, com um portfólio de mais de 200 produtos, todos dermatologicamente testados e aprovados.

Com atuação a nível nacional, possuímos indústria, centro de distribuição, escritório, mais de 130 lojas, presença nas principais redes de farmácias e canal digital.

Somos uma marca de alma, um sentimento de bem-estar e autoestima, por meio de uma experiência personalizada.

Este é o ambiente ideal para aqueles que desejam crescer com ética e protagonizar suas carreiras!



Responsabilidades da Oportunidade:


  • Planejar e controlar a necessidade de materiais conforme demanda de produção (Interna e em Terceiros).
  • Rodar MRP e emitir requisições.
  • Analisar níveis de estoque, giro e cobertura de materiais.
  • Acompanhar phase-in e phase-out de materiais, garantindo a transição adequada.
  • Acompanhar materiais próximos ao vencimento.
  • Direcionar prioridades para atendimento do plano de produção junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Planejar, requisitar e controlar retrabalhos.
  • Elaborar relatórios e indicadores de performance (KPIs).
  • Interagir com as áreas de Produção, Compras, Qualidade e Logística.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia da Produção, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência anterior na função e conhecimento da área.
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote Office com ênfase em excel.
  • Conhecimento em MRP, ERP (preferencialmente SAP).



Benefícios


  • Assistência médica.
  • Assistência odontológica.
  • Refeitório na empresa.
  • Vale alimentação.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Wellhub.
  • Desconto na compra de produtos ADCOS.
  • Produto ADCOS de presente no mês do seu aniversário.
  • PLR.

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow | Especialista Técnico de Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.

Familiarity with Kubernetes.

Experience with cloud-based services (AWS)

Experience with Terraform

Familiarity with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery methodologies and tooling.

A deep proficiency of Java (Sprint and Temporal)

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).

7+ years of professional experience in practice area

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow | Especialista Técnico de Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Senior FreeBSD Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • We are building a team to work on the FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) framework, including hwmon, libpmc, and pmcstat.
  • The project includes development, testing, and cooperation with the upstream FreeBSD open-source community to integrate new features into FreeBSD.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and improve parts of the FreeBSD PMC framework (hwmon, libpmc, pmcstat)
  • Investigate and fix performance and monitoring issues in the FreeBSD kernel
  • Work with the upstream FreeBSD community and integrate changes into mainline FreeBSD
  • Support performance monitoring tools for modern AMD (Zen era) hardware
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7 years of experience in relevant technical areas
  • Strong knowledge of FreeBSD kernel architecture and internals
  • Excellent C programming skills
  • Strong understanding of x86 microarchitecture
  • Very good knowledge of performance monitoring on modern x86 systems

title: Desenvolvedor Java com AWS
description:
Desenvolvedor Java com AWS


Local: atuação remota

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Nível: Pleno


Sobre a Vaga:

Como Desenvolvedor Java com AWS, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações escaláveis e eficientes na nuvem. Você trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções que atendam às necessidades dos nossos clientes e do negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em Java, garantindo alta qualidade e desempenho.

- Projetar e implementar soluções utilizando Amazon Web Services (AWS), como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda.

- Colaborar com equipes de design e produto para definir requisitos e especificações das aplicações.

- Participar de revisões de código e garantir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

- Implementar e manter processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).

- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho e segurança nas aplicações.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando Java.

- Conhecimento prático em AWS e serviços relacionados.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

- Experiência em frameworks Java, como Spring ou Hibernate.

- Compreensão de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil e metodologias DevOps.

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e colaborar de forma eficaz.

- Conhecimento de ambientes de governança do seguimento financeiro.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento frontend (ex.: React, Angular) é um diferencial.

title: Desenhista Projetista de instalações Hidráulicas e Combate a Incêndio
description:
Descrição da vaga

Oportunidade Hidráulica/Incêndio: Empresa em São Paulo - Vila Mariana - do ramo de projetos de instalações prediais procura Desenhista Projetista para instalações hidráulicas e combate a incêndio com as seguintes qualificações:


Condições exigidas

Experiência anterior de no mínimo de 1 ano de projetos para desenhista projetista - de instalações hidráulica e incêndio prediais nos segmentos logístico, corporativo, hospitalar, industrial e/ou residencial.


Pleno domínio do Auto Cad (obrigatório)

Pleno domínio em Revit MEP (desejável)

Conhecimento e familiaridade com as principais normas brasileiras referentes a água fria, água quente, pluviais, proteção e combate a incêndio, IT de bombeiros.


Habilidades desejadas

Bons conhecimentos do Excel que possibilite o desenvolvimento de planilhas específicas.

Comunicação clara e objetiva.

title: Java Developer Specialist (AWS)
description:
We expect you to be Software engineer with experience building Acceptance and Integration Test Suites in the Enterprise. It helps to have advanced experience working with testing frameworks like cucumber/gherkin, as well as Artillery for load testing.

WORK AS A CONTRACTOR - PST TIME ZONE- 7+ years of professional experience in practice area


A day in the life…

• Contributes to multidimensional projects that involve multiple teams.

• Works with other software engineers on design best practices and conducts code reviews.

• Resolves complex engineering problems, collaborating with others.

• Facilitates cross functional troubleshooting, root cause analysis and engages others when needed.

• Responsible for creating, evaluating, and contributing to feature detailed designs.

• Design, develop, and implement software utilizing an agile project cycle.

• Mentor others on the team and raise the bar for technical knowledge across a wide spectrum.

• Demonstrates thorough knowledge of information technology concepts issues, trends and best practices as they relate to Cloud technologies and system integrations.

• Apply and share knowledge of security coding practices and secure system fundamentals.


Requirement

Needing Someone who would has built an orchestrator in Java or .net, they would have used temporal IO on a project in recent work history. They would have experience with Kafka and Kubernetes, They would possess Devops skillsets where they could build the first pipelines. Has advanced exp working with testing frameworks like cucumber, gherkin, as well as artillery testing.

Software engineer that USED to be a Test engineer would potentially be a good fit for the needs of this role.

Familiarity with Kubernetes.

Familiarity with relational databases - Postgres

Experience with RESTful architecture and micro-services.

Experience with Kafka

Experience with cloud-based services (AWS)

Experience with Terraform

Familiarity with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery methodologies and tooling.

A deep proficiency of Java (Sprint and Temporal)

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).

7+ years of professional experience in practice area

description:
We expect you to be Software engineer with experience building Acceptance and Integration Test Suites in the Enterprise. It helps to have advanced experience working with testing frameworks like cucumber/gherkin, as well as Artillery for load testing.

WORK AS A CONTRACTOR - PST TIME ZONE- 7+ years of professional experience in practice area


A day in the life…

• Contributes to multidimensional projects that involve multiple teams.

• Works with other software engineers on design best practices and conducts code reviews.

• Resolves complex engineering problems, collaborating with others.

• Facilitates cross functional troubleshooting, root cause analysis and engages others when needed.

• Responsible for creating, evaluating, and contributing to feature detailed designs.

• Design, develop, and implement software utilizing an agile project cycle.

• Mentor others on the team and raise the bar for technical knowledge across a wide spectrum.

• Demonstrates thorough knowledge of information technology concepts issues, trends and best practices as they relate to Cloud technologies and system integrations.

• Apply and share knowledge of security coding practices and secure system fundamentals.


Requirement

Needing Someone who would has built an orchestrator in Java or .net, they would have used temporal IO on a project in recent work history. They would have experience with Kafka and Kubernetes, They would possess Devops skillsets where they could build the first pipelines. Has advanced exp working with testing frameworks like cucumber, gherkin, as well as artillery testing.

Software engineer that USED to be a Test engineer would potentially be a good fit for the needs of this role.

Familiarity with Kubernetes.

Familiarity with relational databases - Postgres

Experience with RESTful architecture and micro-services.

Experience with Kafka

Experience with cloud-based services (AWS)

Experience with Terraform

Familiarity with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery methodologies and tooling.

A deep proficiency of Java (Sprint and Temporal)

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).

7+ years of professional experience in practice area

title: Analista de Operações e Dados
description:
A PROLUNO é uma startup de ensino à distância fundada em 2017. Nosso propósito é democratizar a educação digital, permitindo que professores criem e distribuam conteúdos de qualidade de forma simples e acessível.


Hoje, impactamos quase 1.000 professores em todo o Brasil e seguimos crescendo


Seu desafio no dia a dia

Garantir uma jornada de leads e alunos orientada a dados, com processos estruturados, automações e análises estratégicas que aumentem retenção, engajamento e crescimento da base.


Responsabilidades :

  • Estruturar e analisar pesquisas com leads e alunos;
  • Construir dashboards e consolidar dados de múltiplas plataformas;
  • Monitorar indicadores como Retenção, Engajamento, NPS, CSAT e Churn;
  • Gerar insights estratégicos para tomada de decisão;
  • Configurar e otimizar automações e processos escaláveis;
  • Criar e manter playbooks e materiais no Notion;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua da jornada de leads e alunos, em parceria com as lideranças;
  • Apresentação de relatório executivo.


Requisitos :

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Marketing, Gestão de Processos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel ou Google Planilhas em nível avançado;
  • Experiência na estruturação e análise de dashboards operacionais e estratégicos;
  • Noções de Business Intelligence (BI) e análise de dados;
  • Vivência com Typeform e Google Forms para criação, organização e análise de pesquisas;
  • Conhecimento básico em CRM;
  • Noções de automações (Manychat ou ferramentas similares);
  • Experiência na organização e documentação de processos no Notion;
  • Boa familiaridade com o ChatGPT como ferramenta estratégica;


Competências comportamentais:

  • Pensamento analítico e estratégico, com foco em decisões orientadas a dados;
  • Perfil organizado, criterioso e atento aos detalhes;
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua, eficiência e escala;
  • Proatividade na identificação e solução de problemas;
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e baseada em dados;
  • Capacidade de priorização em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Visão sistêmica, conectando dados, processos e estratégia.


O que oferecemos :

Salário fixo;

Ajuda de custo;

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow | Especialista Técnico de Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

Local: atuação remota

Como Desenvolvedor Java com AWS, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações escaláveis e eficientes na nuvem. Você trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções que atendam às necessidades dos nossos clientes e do negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em Java, garantindo alta qualidade e desempenho.

- Projetar e implementar soluções utilizando Amazon Web Services (AWS), como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda.

- Colaborar com equipes de design e produto para definir requisitos e especificações das aplicações.

- Participar de revisões de código e garantir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

- Implementar e manter processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).

- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho e segurança nas aplicações.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando Java.

- Conhecimento prático em AWS e serviços relacionados.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

- Experiência em frameworks Java, como Spring ou Hibernate.

- Compreensão de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil e metodologias DevOps.

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e colaborar de forma eficaz.

- Conhecimento de ambientes de governança do seguimento financeiro.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento frontend (ex.: React, Angular) é um diferencial.

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Especialista de Middleware (Produção)
description:
Atividades:

  • Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;
  • Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;
  • Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;
  • Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);
  • Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;
  • Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;
  • Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;
  • Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;
  • Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;
  • Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;
  • Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;
  • Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;
  • Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;
  • Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs.
  • Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.


Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;
  • Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR;
  • Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;
  • Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;
  • Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;
  • Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;
  • Experiência em camada de observabilidade;
  • Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;
  • Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Billing, Ciclo de Receita, Ordering e Integrações;
  • Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;
  • Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;
  • Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);
  • Trabalho Remoto ou Híbrido.
  • Apoio a certificações;
  • Day off no mês do seu aniversário;

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .
